assets.prompt: Redesign the supplied blue block sprite into a brighter, shinier premium casual mobile puzzle game tile. ONE rounded SQUARE tile, perfectly front-facing orthographic, not a cube. Maintain broad flat center panel for black HP numbers to be rendered later. Cheerful vivid luminous azure BLUE (#258FFF center), saturated medium blue bevel along lower/right edge, short clean bright white curved specular streak at upper-left rim, thin cool pale-blue top edge highlight, soft glossy candy/plastic finish with subtle puffy depth. Center panel smooth and even, no extreme gradient, no dark navy shading, no center glare, no symbols, no text. Elegant polished bevel rather than thick black border. Uniform corner radius about 10% of tile width. Shape should fill 96% width and 96% height with equal 2% transparent margin on square canvas. Real transparent alpha background, no external glow or ground shadow, no debris, no perspective tilt. Clean production sprite readable at 32px, cohesive bright toy-like block game art.

Edit reference: the glossy BLUE rounded square tile. Create the RED color variant for the SAME 10-color mobile puzzle block sprite set. Recolor every blue/cyan surface into bright candy scarlet RED, center #FF5148, rich red lower bevel, pale coral highlights. Preserve the front-facing perfectly square silhouette, bevel thickness, corner radius, large smooth evenly lit center for black HP numerals, and upper-left white glossy streak. Keep material very glossy polished candy plastic and colors fresh and bright. Single tile fills 92% of square canvas with equal transparent margins. Clean antialiased rounded-square silhouette with absolutely NO fringe, splatter, flecks, sparkles or disconnected pixels outside the tile. No text, no numerals, no icons, no border box, no shadow outside, no perspective. True transparent alpha background. All original blue must be replaced with the requested color.
